headline: Audacity 4 is a complete revamp of the ‘world’s most popular’ audio editor
summary: Audacity 4, a major update to the popular audio editor, has been released. It features a new, less controversial icon after an early design caused a stir. The update brings promised improvements to the software's functionality.

headline: The White House is making arcade games racist
summary: The White House released policy-themed 'arcade' games, some with racist undertones. These games are modeled on existing titles, potentially causing copyright issues. The Tetris Company has already reacted to the 'Build the Wall' clone.

headline: GoPro says it’s still committed ‘to your collective stoke’
summary: GoPro CEO Nick Woodman reassured customers about the company's commitment to camera making. This follows a proposed $285 million acquisition by Starman. Woodman believes the merger will enhance GoPro's content creation tech development.

headline: Roland is getting into generative AI music with Melody Flip
summary: Roland is entering generative AI music with its new Melody Flip tool. Available as a DAW plug-in, it offers 250 'Palettes' of musical ideas by genre. Users can start with existing melodies or AI-generated suggestions.

headline: Tetris Responds After Trump Administration Launches 'Build the Wall' Clone Game
summary: Official Tetris pages have issued a response regarding a new game. The Trump administration launched a clone titled 'Build the Wall.' This game mimics the classic Tetris gameplay.

headline: Hideki Kamiya Isn't Fussed About the Physical vs. Digital Debate – He Just Wants Games to Be Preserved for Future Generations
summary: Hideki Kamiya, creator of Bayonetta, isn't concerned with physical vs. digital game formats. His main focus is on game preservation for future players. He believes accessibility over time is paramount for the medium.

headline: 9 Game and Movie Trailers Worth Watching This Week
summary: A curated list of 9 new game and movie trailers has been released. Highlights include Street Fighter, Stranger Than Heaven, and buzzy festival movies. The selection also features horror schlock and super-stylish indie titles.

headline: How to Watch Free Movies and TV Shows on Your PS5
summary: This guide provides instructions on accessing free movies. Learn how to stream TV shows using your PS5 console. Discover various platforms and methods available for entertainment.

headline: 'I'd rather die than ring the police': Distrust and fear in Middlesbrough after A66 crash
summary: Violence has escalated in Middlesbrough following a fatal A66 crash. Residents report living in fear and distrust the police. BBC News visited the town to document the community's concerns.

headline: Cleveland police chief proud of force but being 'let down' by funding
summary: Cleveland Police Chief Victoria Fuller expressed pride in her force's efforts. She states the force is 'let down' by insufficient funding. Fuller advocates for Cleveland Police to join a larger, strategic force with more resources.

headline: Farage threatens to overhaul Lords and judges to meet his pledges
summary: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage has vowed to overhaul the House of Lords. He also threatens changes to the judiciary. These reforms are promised within the first 100 days if Reform UK wins power.

headline: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
summary: The UN has voted to adopt a new world map, sponsored by Togo. This map aims to accurately reflect Africa's actual size, which is often misrepresented. The resolution passed with 164 nations in favor, with the US being the sole opposing vote.
